levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد ابن الوليد

notes: the report is a list of five routes separated by «؛»: the father routes, the Muhammad b. al-Hasan route, the single name al-Hasan b. Zarif, and the Ayyub b. Nuh route
the routes that meet at هشام بن سالم are joined by «جميعا» and «و»; which route the father's two mentions belong to is not settled by the text
«محمد بن أبي عمير» and «علي بن الحكم» are co-transmitters of Hisham (owner check requested)
the honorifics «رضي الله عنهما» and «رضي اللّه عنه» are left out
